author: Snusky
body: Monuments spawn in the overworld and are similar to dungeons, exept you can choose which path to take every time you enter them for more drops of a particular path, you have 4 different monuments (thor, irthra, demeter and vulcan i think) and after completing the monuments you get different buffs for a limited time, the monuments look like archways in different colors(thor is yellow/brown in color)

author: dimizar
body: It's basically a dungeon with extra steps
